title: Bari Weiss Has a ‘Confession’ for Ben Shapiro
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In today's edition, Bari Weiss comes running to the
aid of fellow pro-Israel ideologue Ben Shapiro, using The Free Press to
promote his latest right-wing propaganda film while charging her subscribers
$250 a pop for the honor of watching it. Would any other news network head get
away with this? Plus, Mamdani Derangement Syndrome continues to rage on the
right, and the MAGA vibes are down bad.

# **Only Bari Weiss and Co. Think Ben Shapiro 's 'Confession' Is Good**

###### Video source: [Chris Menahan/@infolibnews on
X](https://x.com/infolibnews/status/2122058190082965818)

  
The head of CBS News just screened an anti-communist propaganda film written
by the founder of a far-right media empire, charging $250 a person for the
opportunity to not only view the movie, but also to see her chat it up with
the screenwriter.

This exclusive event also gave the Tiffany Network's editor-in-chief a chance
to issue her full-throated endorsement of the film, which has so far received
[less-than-stellar
reviews](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/confession_2026/reviews).
